transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling TechSolutions Support. This is Mark. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Mark, I’m having issues with my Pro Plan billing. I was charged twice this month!

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that! Let’s look into your account. Can you please provide me with the email address associated with your account?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s john.doe@example.com. I really need this sorted out because that charge has thrown off my budget.

**Agent:** I understand how important this is. One moment while I review your billing history… Okay, I do see two charges for this month. It appears there was an error on our end.

**Customer:** That’s really frustrating. When will I get my refund?

**Agent:** I can initiate that refund for you right now. It typically takes 3-5 business days to process back to your account.

**Customer:** Okay, that’s good to know. But how did this even happen?

**Agent:** We had a temporary glitch in our billing system this month, which affected a few customers. We're actively working to resolve it. 

**Customer:** I appreciate that you’re fixing it. Just to clarify, I’m still maintaining the same services, right?

**Agent:** Yes, your Pro Plan remains unaffected regarding services. You’ll still have access to all features, plus we’ll include a month of premium support for the inconvenience.

**Customer:** That sounds fair. Thank you for being helpful, Mark.

**Agent:** You’re most welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

**Customer:** No, I think that covers it. I appreciate your quick response on this!

**Agent:** Thank you for reaching out, John! If you need any more help, don’t hesitate to contact us. Have a great day!
